🚦 TRAFFIC ADVISORY 🚦
In connection with Eid-ul-Fitr (Ramzan) on 21-03-2026 (7:00 AM to 11:30 AM), heavy public gatherings are expected at:
📍 Mir Alam Tank (near Zoo Park)
📍 Hockey Ground, Masab Tank
⚠️ Expect traffic congestion at:
Bahadurpura, Kalapather, Nawab Saheb Kunta, Shastripuram, Danamma Huts, Masab Tank, Khaja Mansion, NMDC & 1/12 Junction
👮‍♂️ Commuters are advised to plan travel in advance and use alternate routes.
#HyderabadTraffic #TrafficAdvisory #EidUlFitr #Ramzan #CommuterAlert
